description: Catalog of executable browser-control commands the decision model may choose from. Each entry maps 1:1 to a real Chrome extension API call so the backend's command-dispatcher can execute the decision model's output without re-interpreting intent. 'tier' matches the model-tiering table in the architecture doc.

commands.name: open_tab
commands.description: Open a new tab, optionally navigating straight to a URL.

active.note: set false for Parallel Mode (background open)

commands.name: close_tab
commands.description: Close one or more tabs by tabId.

commands.name: go_to_url
commands.description: Navigate an existing tab to a specific URL.

commands.name: go_to_site
commands.description: Fuzzy-resolve a spoken site/app name (e.g. 'Best Buy', 'the laptop shopping app') against open tabs' titles/URLs first, and only fall back to a fresh navigation/search if no open tab matches. This is the command the small model reaches for when the request names a site rather than a literal URL.
commands.chrome_api: chrome.tabs.query + chrome.tabs.update (fallback: chrome.tabs.create with a search/direct URL)

commands.name: switch_tab
commands.description: Switch the active tab/window focus to a specific tab (does not navigate).

commands.name: go_back
commands.description: Navigate a tab back one entry in its history.

tabId.note: defaults to active tab of current window

commands.name: go_forward
commands.description: Navigate a tab forward one entry in its history ('fastforward').

commands.name: reload_tab
commands.description: Reload a tab, optionally bypassing cache.

commands.name: scroll
commands.description: Scroll the page in a direction or to an element/position.

targetSelector.note: used for 'find the paragraph about X' style scroll-to

commands.name: set_zoom
commands.description: Change page zoom level.

commands.name: mute_tab
commands.description: Mute or unmute a tab's audio.

commands.name: bookmark_tab
commands.description: Bookmark the given tab's URL.

commands.name: get_history
commands.description: Search recent browsing history, e.g. to re-find a page the user mentions by description.

commands.name: get_page_text
commands.description: Extract visible page text (and interactive element list) for the decision model to reason over, e.g. 'find the paragraph about wildfires on this page'.

commands.name: capture_screenshot
commands.description: Capture the visible area of a tab. Only called after the cheap model calls escalate_to_vision and text/DOM alone isn't enough.

commands.name: click_at_coordinates
commands.description: Click a precise (x, y) point on the page — used for multi-step UI tasks on unfamiliar layouts, since it's more reliable than synthetic DOM click events.

commands.name: type_text
commands.description: Type text into whatever element currently has focus (e.g. after clicking a chat input) — used for multi-step tasks like 'ask it for the 20 best places to visit'.
commands.chrome_api: chrome.debugger.sendCommand: Input.insertText (or Input.dispatchKeyEvent per character for sites that reject insertText)

commands.name: press_key
commands.description: Dispatch a single key press (e.g. Enter to submit a form/chat message).

commands.name: escalate_to_vision
commands.description: Not a browser action — the cheap model's explicit escape hatch when text/DOM data isn't enough to complete the request. Triggers capture_screenshot + a call to the vision-capable decision model rather than executing anything directly.

commands.name: group_tabs
commands.description: Group related tabs together (optional UI polish, e.g. grouping all tabs opened by one multi-step task).

notes.debugger_caveat: Attaching chrome.debugger shows Chrome's yellow 'is being debugged' infobar — surface this in the side-panel log so it isn't mistaken for a bug. Only the domains Accessibility, Audits, CacheStorage, Console, CSS, Database, Debugger, DOM, DOMDebugger, DOMSnapshot, Emulation, Fetch, IO, Input, Inspector, Log, Network, Overlay, Page, Performance, Profiler, Runtime, Storage, Target, Tracing, WebAudio, WebAuthn are exposed through chrome.debugger.
